Messages.Body:
Hatch the Viper Retainer
pro+ser the minion with this retainer can prevent 1 damage
each combat. he opposing minion takes 1 damage each round
during strike resolution if the range is close.
PRO+SER as above but the opposing minion takes 2 damage

Homunculus, Retainer, Protean
Retainer with 1 life.
[pro] During any Methuselah`s untap phase, the vampire with this
retainer can burn 1 blood to untap.
[PRO] As above, but Homunculus has 2 life.

Camarilla Vitae Slave, Retainer, 2 blood, Lasombra
Retainer with 1 life. The vampire with this retainer increases his or
her capacity by 1. During each of his or her controller`s master
phases, he or she may choose a basic level Discipline he or she
possesses. He or she then has the chosen Discipline at the superior
level until his or her controller`s next master phase.

Do these all have no designation? i.e. mortal, animal, wraith, demon
Or have I missed something?

How about construct.
